The `tkinter` package (“Tk interface”) is the standard Python interface to the Tcl/Tk GUI toolkit. Both Tk and `tkinter` are available on most Unix platforms, including macOS, as well as on Windows systems. [...] Tk
:   Tk is a Tcl package implemented in C that adds custom commands to create and manipulate GUI widgets. Each `Tk` object embeds its own Tcl interpreter instance with Tk loaded into it.
